description: A `yield` with a non-empty `inputs:` still falls back to a bare sibling reference once its own narrow `inputs:` overlay misses -- `{{x}}` reads the declared input, `{{a.value}}` still reaches sibling `a` ("X / A"). Fails (renders "X / ") on main, where a `yield`'s own `inputs:` scope has no bare-reference fallback at all.
